visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a vertical split-screen. On the left, a man wearing a black hoodie with white text on the chest represents a 'Rookie Japan Tourist.' On the right, the same man wears a dusty pink t-shirt and a silver chain necklace representing a 'Professional Japan Tourist.' Both are in front of blurred supermarket shelves stocked with colorful products. Red text boxes at the top label each character. (2) Various beauty and health products are showcased through high-resolution product photography overlays. A jar of Dieufra Premium Sun Block Powder appears first, followed by white jars of wrinkle-white gel and Rezept II essence bottles. The man in the pink shirt on the right remains visible, gesturing toward these items while the character on the left looks increasingly distressed and overwhelmed. (3) The sequence shifts to show household and lifestyle items. A cat-shaped floral shopping bag is displayed, followed by a black ergonomic backpack and a specialized waist pack. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the studio-like environment. The 'Professional' character points at these items with a calm expression, while the 'Rookie' character mimes struggling with heavy weight. (4) The final phase features a collage of various Japanese stationery and lifestyle goods, including wooden rulers and colorful accessories. The split-screen persists with the character on the left appearing physically exhausted, leaning back with closed eyes, while the character on the right smiles broadly and claps his hands together in a satisfied gesture.
